channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Luguentz Dort | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Luguentz Dort from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Dillon Brooks on Luguentz Dort
item.description:
Dillon Brooks on which team hacks the most in the NBA.

“OKC. 100%. Lu Dort if you’re watching, Lu Dort you’re a hack. He’s one of my team Canada teammates.”

Dillon Brooks on Luguentz Dort, Feb 1, 2026. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Sam Presti on Luguentz Dort
item.description:
Sam Presti on Lu Dort reflects back to OKC's rebuild:

“When we were getting our teeth kicked in.. Lu was making what we call catalyst plays. Like, we might be down by 15 points.. and we'd be outmatched at times.. but he'd be diving on the floor, harassing somebody up the court.. To me, that's what stands out about Lu. The things we've seen on the biggest stages, he was doing those things when there wasn't incentive to do them.”

Sam Presti on Luguentz Dort, Sep 25, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Brooks Barnhizer on Alex Caruso, Luguentz Dort
item.description:
Brandon Rahbar:Brooks Barnhizer on players he’s looking forward to work with:

“Caruso and Dort, guys who are kind of similar to my path. If I can be fit from that same cloth one day…”

Brooks Barnhizer on Alex Caruso, Luguentz Dort, Jun 28, 2025. Source: Twitter @BrandonRahbar.

item.title: Mark Daigneault on Luguentz Dort
item.description:
Mark Daigneault on Lu Dort:

“There's a special thing about him. He's always going to stand back up. He's not perfect, but he's always going to gonna respond, he's always gonna compete, you always can count on him to do that. I don't like betting against that guy.”

Mark Daigneault on Luguentz Dort, May 14, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Mark Daigneault on Luguentz Dort
item.description:
Mark Daigneault on sticking with Lu Dort:

“Yeah I don’t bet against Lu. It’s that simple. There’s just a special thing about him.”

Mark Daigneault on Luguentz Dort, May 14, 2025. Source: Twitter @BrandonRahbar.

item.title: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander on Luguentz Dort
item.description:
SGA on Lu Dort’s 3s tonight:

“It’s clear as day we wouldn’t have been able to win tonight if he didn’t hit those shots. Nothing out of the ordinary.. That’s who Lu is.”

Shai Gilgeous-Alexander on Luguentz Dort, May 14, 2025. Source: Twitter @BrandonRahbar.

item.title: Mark Daigneault on Luguentz Dort
item.description:
Joel Lorenzi:Mark Daigneault on Lu Dort’s shooting:

“I definitely trust the body of work over time more than small sample sizes. If the question is whether or not I’m confident in his 3-point shooting, I am. He’s the last guy I’m worried about. But we also have a deep team.”

Mark Daigneault on Luguentz Dort, May 11, 2025. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Aaron Wiggins on Luguentz Dort
item.description:
Aaron Wiggins on Lu Dort not being a DPOY finalist:

“I think it’s insane. I do think there’s a lack of — I don’t wanna say attention to our team, but in terms of the way we played statistically defensively and the year we had, that doesn’t happen without elite defensive players. Lu specifically is the main dude. He guards the best guards, the best wings, and even sometimes the forwards. I’ve watched him for years now not get credit for the work that he does.”

Aaron Wiggins on Luguentz Dort, Apr 21, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Cason Wallace on Alex Caruso, Luguentz Dort
item.description:
Joel Lorenzi:Cason Wallace on the lineups he shares with Alex Caruso and Lu Dort:

“I like the way we all fly around and play off each other. We kinda have the same feel and instincts on the defensive end,so it makes it easier to read each other.”

Cason Wallace on Alex Caruso, Luguentz Dort, Oct 19, 2024. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Mark Daigneault on Luguentz Dort
item.description:
Mark Daigneault on SGA and Lu Dort’s leadership growth:

“The most important part of their leadership is how they walk and how they act… You know, they’re not giving any speeches today. But it accumulates over time and they’ve built a tremendous amount of credibility inside the building because of that.”

Mark Daigneault on Luguentz Dort, Oct 1, 2024. Source: Twitter @BrandonRahbar.

item.title: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander on Luguentz Dort
item.description:
Shai Gilgeous-Alexander on Lu Dort:

“Me and Lu go way back... It's cool to have someone to go through the whole process with. See their growth, they see your growth. Share your successes and your failures with.”

Shai Gilgeous-Alexander on Luguentz Dort, Oct 1, 2024. Source: Twitter @BrandonRahbar.

item.title: Anthony Edwards on Luguentz Dort
item.description:
Anthony Edwards on Lu Dort:

“I thought he should’ve been on one of the Defensive Teams, for sure.”

Anthony Edwards on Luguentz Dort, May 22, 2024. Source: Twitter @BrandonRahbar.

item.title: Chet Holmgren on Luguentz Dort
item.description:
Chet Holmgren on Lu Dort's lack of defensive accolades:

“I don't know what more he could do honestly. Extremely talented. He deserves more votes, more recognition for that type of stuff.”

Chet Holmgren on Luguentz Dort, May 19, 2024. Source: Twitter @CAlmanza1007.

item.title: Mark Daigneault on Luguentz Dort
item.description:
Mark Daigneault on Lu Dort:

“It takes humility to guard guys like that… He’s had games where he gotten lit up by those guys because they’re really good players and that’s what they do. But it never impacts his effort.”

Mark Daigneault on Luguentz Dort, Apr 26, 2024. Source: Twitter @CAlmanza1007.

item.title: Jaylin Williams on Luguentz Dort
item.description:
Joel Lorenzi:Jaylin Williams on Lu Dort:

“He’s a pure person, for sure. You look at Lu, you think he’s this tough guy that doesn’t talk to anybody, doesn’t joke around. … I thought Lu was gonna be this dude that didn’t talk to nobody. … He’s sending memes to our group chat.”

Jaylin Williams on Luguentz Dort, Apr 23, 2024. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Mark Daigneault on Brandon Ingram, Luguentz Dort
item.description:
Mark Daigneault on Lu Dort’s defense on Brandon Ingram:

“He was on it. He was really on it. Really disruptive. I thought Dub did a really great job on Ingram. Thought Kenrich did a great job on Ingram. Wallace did a great job on McCollum.”

Mark Daigneault on Brandon Ingram, Luguentz Dort, Apr 22, 2024. Source: Twitter @BrandonRahbar.

item.title: Mark Daigneault on Luguentz Dort
item.description:
Mark Daigneault on Lu Dort's postseason performances:

“He just rises to the level of the game. That's just how he's been really from Day 1... His worst moments are when the level of the game isn't as high... He's at his absolute best when the games get big.”

Mark Daigneault on Luguentz Dort, Apr 18, 2024. Source: Twitter @CAlmanza1007.

item.title: Mark Daigneault on Luguentz Dort, Jalen Williams
item.description:
“The fact that we have (Jalen Williams) and (Lugentz) Dort who can take the point-of-attack guys, it allows him to use his great help anticipation. He’s got great hands, great length and he really smells the ball at this point. So he deserves credit as an individual defender. But (Williams and Dort) get credit for his ability to get the steals because a lot of that’s coming off the ball.”

Mark Daigneault on Luguentz Dort, Jalen Williams, Jan 25, 2024. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Mark Daigneault on Luguentz Dort
item.description:
Mark Daigneault on Lu Dort:

“He’s just a dog competitively. Guys hit big shots and they make faces where they’re like reacting to the shot they just hit. When he lined up on Curry on that last possession, he kinda has that on defense… He loves that moment.”

Mark Daigneault on Luguentz Dort, Dec 10, 2023. Source: Twitter @CAlmanza1007.

item.title: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander on Luguentz Dort
item.description:
SGA on how cool it is to see Lu Dort play at home during their preseason game against the Pistons:

“I know the feeling. I get to every year. It’s a special feeling to be able to play in front of your family and friends… He’ll have a lot of fun that night. I’m happy for him.”

Shai Gilgeous-Alexander on Luguentz Dort, Oct 4, 2023. Source: Twitter @CAlmanza1007.

item.title: Jordi Fernandez on Dillon Brooks, Luguentz Dort
item.description:
Donatas Urbonas:Jordi Fernandez on Dillon Brooks:

“I'm really proud of Dillon. This is how it looks when they let Dillon Brooks play. And it's just not about the defensive end. With Lu Dort, he's the best perimeter in the World Cup. But he's also extremely efficient offensively.”

Jordi Fernandez on Dillon Brooks, Luguentz Dort, Sep 10, 2023. Source: Twitter @Urbodo.

item.title: Paul George on Luguentz Dort
item.description:
Brandon Rahbar:Paul George on his injury and Lu Dort:

“He wasn’t trying to hurt me. He just plays hard. He can get wild at times but he’s a hard worker,he plays hard. I don’t knock him for competing. It was just a freak accident.”

Paul George on Luguentz Dort, Mar 27, 2023. Source: Twitter @BrandonRahbar.

item.title: Jalen Williams on Luguentz Dort
item.description:
Clemente Almanza:Jalen Williams on Lu Dort’s game preparation:

“I just know whenever Lu gets his dreads done, he’s locked in.”

Jalen Williams on Luguentz Dort, Dec 22, 2022. Source: Twitter @CAlmanza1007.

item.title: Sam Presti on Luguentz Dort
item.description:
Joe Mussatto:Presti on a possible Dort extension:

“We'll definitely have a conversation on that. I don't know when those conversations will pick up. We'll have some different options. I don't want to get into all of them.”

Sam Presti on Luguentz Dort, Apr 18, 2022. Source: Twitter @joe_mussatto.

item.title: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander on Luguentz Dort
item.description:
Brandon Rahbar:SGA on Dort ejection:

“Lu's obviously not a dirty player. I don't think Lu would ever try to elbow someone in the face.”

Shai Gilgeous-Alexander on Luguentz Dort, Jan 23, 2022. Source: Twitter @BrandonRahbar.

item.title: Donovan Mitchell on Luguentz Dort
item.description:
Joe Mussatto:Quin Snyder was asked about Lu Dort having the most success of any player in the league when guarding Donovan Mitchell:

“My guess is you could say that about Lu Dort with a lot of guys.”

Donovan Mitchell on Luguentz Dort, Oct 21, 2021. Source: Twitter @joe_mussatto.

item.title: James Bouknight on Luguentz Dort
item.description:
Brandon Rahbar:James Bouknight on his fit with OKC:

“Me and Shai in the backcourt, I feel like that can be a deadly young backcourt. Then you put Dort in there, I feel like that can be something special. We could build something in Oklahoma.”

James Bouknight on Luguentz Dort, Jul 26, 2021. Source: Twitter @BrandonRahbar.

item.title: Sam Presti on Luguentz Dort
item.description:
Presti on Lu Dort:

“He wasn’t drafted. That shows how smart all of us all. He has the mental makeup to run a very long race compared to the other players in the draft class.”

Sam Presti on Luguentz Dort, May 20, 2021. Source: Twitter @BrandonRahbar.

item.title: Al Horford on Luguentz Dort
item.description:
Brandon Rahbar:Al Horford on Lu Dort:

“Lu made big strides this season. Especially with his 3 point shooting. He’s not hesitant anymore. He’s a very unique player. I’m not sure who to compare him to. I know he’s an elite defender. A very elite defender.”

Al Horford on Luguentz Dort, May 17, 2021. Source: Twitter @BrandonRahbar.

item.title: Theo Maledon on Luguentz Dort
item.description:
Brandon Rahbar:Theo Maledon on SGA and Lu Dort:

“It’s been great to learn from both of those guys. I try to see what they’re doing that works and put it into my game.”

Theo Maledon on Luguentz Dort, Mar 30, 2021. Source: Twitter @BrandonRahbar.
